newsitem.title: UK: UK shares crumble as rate fears weigh on Wall St.
newsitem.headline: UK shares crumble as rate fears weigh on Wall St.

text.p: UK shares closed sharply lower on Monday, tracking Wall Street as the Dow weakened ahead of a widely-expected rise in U.S. interest rates on Tuesday.

Retreating from Friday's record close, the FTSE 100 index closed 48.7 points lower at 4,645.2, with decliners in a more than four-to-one majority. Trading volume reached a modest 567 million shares by the London close.

Participants said it was no surprise the UK market was showing signs of nerves ahead of a forecast quarter-point rise in U.S. rates, with the FTSE 100 looking vulnerable after its record-breaking post-election surge.
